email.footer: This email was sent via the {brand} property management platform.

welcome.subject: Welcome to the {property} management system
welcome.title: Welcome, {name}
welcome.body1: Your digital management system for {property} is ready.
welcome.body2: From this panel you can view your dues balance, pay online, report faults and follow announcements.

magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link
magicLink.title: One-click sign-in
magicLink.body1: The link below is valid for {minutes} minutes and can be used only once.
magicLink.body2: If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.

duesReminder.subject: {period} dues reminder — {unit}
duesReminder.title: Your dues for {period}
duesReminder.transparency: The payment page shows the platform fee and the bank commission separately.

certificate.subjectOutstanding: Your debt status certificate is ready ({serialNo})
certificate.body: Please find attached the certificate issued for {unit}.
certificate.note: The certificate can be verified online using the verification code.

meetingInvite.subject: {property} — {title}
meetingInvite.proxyNote: If you cannot attend, you may send a proxy with a written authorisation (Condominium Act art. 31).

kvkkRequest.subject: Your data protection request was received ({requestNo})
kvkkRequest.title: Your data protection request was received
kvkkRequest.body: Your request will be resolved by {date} at the latest (KVKK art. 13).
kvkkRequest.footerNote: This notice is part of the data controller's statutory duty to inform.

dunning.subject: {title} — {property}
dunning.body: We couldn't collect the {amount} payment for your {property} subscription.
dunning.suspendedNote: Your account is currently read-only. Your data has not been deleted; all features return once payment is made.
dunning.updateNote: Update your card details to continue without interruption.

loginCode.subject: Your sign-in verification code
loginCode.title: Sign-in verification code
loginCode.body1: The code is valid for {minutes} minutes and can be used only once.
loginCode.body2: If you didn't request this, someone may know your password — change it as soon as you can.

demoConfirm.subject: Confirm your demo account
demoConfirm.title: Your demo account is ready to be created
demoConfirm.body1: We received your demo request. Click the button below to create your account; the link is valid for {minutes} minutes.
demoConfirm.body2: Once created, the demo account can be used for 24 hours and is then deleted together with all of its data.
demoConfirm.body3: If you did not request this, you can ignore this email; no account is created unless the link is clicked.

demoReady.subject: Your demo account is ready
demoReady.title: Your demo account is ready
demoReady.body1: Your demo account, with every module filled with sample data, is open. You can sign in with:
demoReady.expires: Your demo account is available until {date}; it is then deleted together with all of its data.
demoReady.note: The demo account never sends SMS, WhatsApp or email to real people.

demoReminder.subject: Your demo account is expiring
demoReminder.title: Your demo is about to end
demoReminder.body1: Your demo account expires in about {hours} hours and will then be deleted together with all of its data.
demoReminder.body2: If you liked it, you can open your own property in a few minutes; demo data is not carried over.

bot.optOutConfirm:
I understand you'd like to stop notification messages.

If you confirm, your WhatsApp consent is withdrawn and no further messages are sent to this number. You'll keep receiving dues notices by email.
bot.optOutDone: Your consent has been withdrawn. Your personal data continues to be retained under data protection law; if you want it deleted you can create a request in the app.
bot.cancelled: Cancelled. How can I help you?
bot.identifyPrompt:
Hello! I'm the {brand} property management assistant.

This number isn't linked to a unit yet. Please write your unit number (e.g. A-12).
bot.identifyReceived: Thank you. I've passed your registration for unit {unit} to your manager. Once approved, you'll be able to use this number.
bot.debtNone: ✅ There is no outstanding balance for {unit}. Thank you!
bot.payPrompt:
Amount due: *{amount}*

You can pay by credit/debit card using the secure link below. The payment page shows the platform fee and bank commission separately.
bot.paymentNoticeThanks:
Thank you for letting us know 🙏
Bank transactions are matched automatically and usually appear on your account within a few minutes. If it hasn't appeared by this evening, I'll flag it to your manager.
bot.requestCategoryPrompt: Let's create a fault report. What is it about?
bot.requestCategoryRetry: Please choose a fault category from the list.
bot.requestDescriptionPrompt: Understood. Could you briefly describe the fault? You can also send a photo.
bot.requestCreated:
Your request has been created ✅
Your manager has been notified. I'll update you here as the status changes.
bot.requestCancelled: The request wasn't created. Can I help with anything else?
bot.announcementsNone: There are no published announcements right now.
bot.managerRelay: Write your message here and I'll pass it to your manager.
bot.managerUnknown: No manager details are set. Write your message and I'll pass it to management.
bot.certificatePrompt:
I can prepare a clearance certificate. It reflects your balance at the time of request and is sent as a PDF with a verification code.

Would you like me to create it?
bot.certificateRequested: Your certificate request has been received. If you have no outstanding balance, the PDF will be sent to your email and here within a few minutes.
bot.pollsHint: Use the link in the app to cast your vote.
bot.pollsNone: There are no open polls right now.
bot.reservationPrompt: Which common area would you like to book?
bot.kvkkInfo: You can create data protection requests (access, rectification, erasure) from the *My data requests* screen in the app. Your request is answered within {days} days at the latest.
bot.menuOptions:
You can write:
• *balance* — your current balance
• *pay* — payment link
• *fault* — report a fault
• *news* — latest announcements
• *meeting* — meeting information
• *certificate* — clearance certificate
• *manager* — manager contact
• *stop* — stop messages
bot.thanks: You're welcome 🙂 Can I help with anything else?
bot.fallback: I didn't quite understand that. You can use one of the options below, or ask me to pass your message to the manager.
